content:
*"Keep pushing, you piece of junk!"* Jin snarled inside his mind, his teeth grinding until his jaw muscles screamed. *"If a disciples' dantian cannot withstand a thimble of dew, how does he expect to carry the sword of the Black Sun?!"*

With a brutal surge of sheer biological will, he forced a microscopic thread of violet Qi through the pericardium meridian. The blockage gave way with a wet *pop*. A warm wave of circulation washed into his forearms, restoring sensation to his trembling fingers.

Jin opened his eyes, wiping the bloody mucus from his lip with a vicious smirk. *"One thread. That's all this ancestor needs to start breaking bones."*
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
